summary: Phase 3 regression: KYC auto-verify, Transaction PIN (set/reset via OTP), Change Login Password, Forgot Email, Withdrawal PIN gate, security logs. Backend: 67/67 pytest green (was 59; added 8 new + updated 8 existing for Phase 3 semantics). UI: Login shows both forgot links (login-forgot-link + login-forgot-email-link). /forgot-email renders forgot-email-form with mobile+PAN+DOB, WhatsApp float correctly HIDDEN, wrong PAN surfaces error, correct PAN returns forgot-email-masked. testcust /profile shows KYC 'Verified' pill, security-settings section with all Phase 3 testids present (sec-current-password, sec-new-password, sec-change-password, sec-txn-status='SET ✓' for testcust, sec-txn-send-otp, sec-txn-otp, sec-txn-new, sec-txn-save, sec-logs listing recent events, profile-dob field). Wrong current login password → 400 toast. /withdrawals has withdraw-txn-pin field; wrong PIN (0000) → 'Incorrect transaction password'; correct PIN 5678 → withdrawal created. testcust login password Test@1234 and PIN 5678 CONFIRMED intact (verified via curl POST /api/withdrawals success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1473 lines; strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, security, kyc, wallet, admin_*) before further phases.

require_txn_password lockout logic: on the 5th wrong attempt, `full.get('txn_failed', 0) + 1 >= 5` sets txn_locked_until BUT still raises the same 400 'Incorrect transaction password' on that attempt. Subsequent attempts within 30 min return 429. This is correct but the transition attempt itself doesn't get the 429 — minor UX inconsistency.

recover_email rate-limit key is only the last-10-digits of mobile with a 5/hour cap. Persistent security_logs collection grows unbounded for this; consider TTL index on security_logs.created_at (e.g. 90 days).
announce_campaign_live() and admin_broadcast serial email fan-out is unchanged; still un-throttled — flagged in iter-4 and remains.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook non-conformance) — remains from iter-4.
security_status returns has_txn_password + last 10 log events but does NOT expose the current lock status (txn_locked_until) — customer can't see how long they're locked.

rca of the issue: N/A — no failures on final run. During iteration: (a) initial hardcoded PANs (AAAPZ1234K etc.) collided across test runs since MongoDB retains prior submissions; fixed with uuid-derived _rand_pan(). (b) TestCampaignLiveAnnouncement broadcasts row insert happens AFTER serial email fan-out to all verified customers (currently ~150+) which can exceed 15s; fixed with 20s polling loop. (c) test_recover_email_requires_pan_or_dob hit 429 rate-limit due to prior test attempts using same mobile 9999999999; fixed with unique random mobile. All resolved.
